headline: Handcrafted in Florence for lasting elegance
body: Built by Italian artisans using traditional methods. A bespoke leather handbag made to endure decades, designed for those who appreciate true heritage.
rationale: This copy targets the Affluent Classic by leaning entirely into heritage and craftsmanship, matching her low price sensitivity without mentioning discounts, and using understated language that avoids loud aesthetics or trendy phrasing.
